therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Japanese patients with Type 1 or Type 2 diabetes mellitus
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Self-Monitoring Blood Glucose Levels: Change From Baseline at one year

results.effect_size: Not reported (trial terminated before primary endpoint data collected)
results.target_engagement_evidence: HbA1c reductions observed across subgroups (e.g., -0.42% to -0.93% at Week 6); insulin antibody levels increased in some subgroups
biomarker_changes: HbA1c change from baseline at end of treatment: Type 1 DM -0.22%, Type 2 DM Using Insulin +0.01%, Type 2 DM Not Using Insulin -0.48%
Fasting plasma glucose change from baseline at end of treatment: Type 1 DM +87.3 mg/mL, Type 2 DM Using Insulin +18.3 mg/mL, Type 2 DM Not Using Insulin -8.8 mg/mL
FEV1 change from baseline at end of treatment (all subjects): -0.034 L
FVC change from baseline at end of treatment (all subjects): -0.001 L
FEV1/FVC change from baseline at end of treatment (all subjects): -0.012 L/L
Insulin antibody change from baseline at end of treatment: Type 1 DM +10.52 microU/mL, Type 2 DM Using Insulin +3220.95 microU/mL, Type 2 DM Not Using Insulin +11.42 microU/mL
subgroup_findings: Type 2 DM Using Insulin showed large insulin antibody increases (up to +3630.63 microU/mL at Week 6)
Type 1 DM showed worsening fasting plasma glucose at end of treatment (+87.3 mg/mL)
Hypoglycemia rate 0-3 months: Type 1 DM 3.5 events/subject-month, Type 2 DM Using Insulin 3.2 events/subject-month, Type 2 DM Not Using Insulin 0.1 events/subject-month
safety_signals: Small but consistent decline in FEV1 observed across early timepoints
High hypoglycemia rates in Type 1 and insulin-using Type 2 DM patients in first 3 months

dose_info.dose: adjusted based on self-monitoring of blood glucose
dose_info.schedule: immediately before each meal (three times daily)
dose_info.dose_modifications: Dose adjusted based on self-monitoring blood glucose results before each meal

context.duration: Up to 52 weeks (1 year); trial terminated early, most data up to 26 weeks
context.investigator_commentary: Trial was terminated. See termination reason in detailed description. The trial enrolled Japanese patients across three cohorts (Type 1 DM, Type 2 DM Using Insulin, Type 2 DM Not Using Insulin). Primary endpoint data were not fully collected due to early termination.
